explanation: This is 0 at every D1 and GO step. It is nonzero only at D2 when the agent chose a2 and got the common move to S2, and mostly only around trials 55-78 of the episode (about 8-10 in that range, highest after a streak of rewarded a2-S2 trials, about 3-7 if the previous trial was unrewarded or just after a rare trial). It stays 0 for a1 choices, rare transitions, and a2-to-S2 trials before about trial 50 or after about trial 80.
